dsh-better-edit 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

posts.en:
dsh-better-edit is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1b85706aaea3766d5462.html
